title: Scale uncalibrated — amplitudes are relative only
summary: Absolute mm/s is NOT calibrated (scale_note). Channels report s1 motor housing 2.05 mm/s RMS and s2 PVC pipe 2.70 mm/s RMS with nominal ISO zone C, but these absolute values are not physically credible for this capture and must not be used for ISO 20816 severity. Conclusions below use only frequencies, orders, phase and ratios.

title: Speed identification ambiguous and aliased — kinematics inconclusive
summary: Muse Spark model centrifugal_pump speed posterior MAP 1268.8 rpm p_map=0.395 with 4 competing modes (1268 rpm 0.39, 1134 rpm 0.32, 5787 rpm 0.14, 1796 rpm 0.15), p_map<0.8 threshold for confidence. Instantaneous track speed 2901.4 rpm (48.36 Hz) exceeds Nyquist 15.0 Hz (fps 30) with near_nyquist_warning=true. No order amplitudes detected (1×/2×/3× = 0.0 mm/s) and 17/18 peaks explained only under ambiguous assignment. What-if tests (blades=3→ MAP 5787 rpm p0.48, blades=4→ 4348 rpm p0.40, blades=6→ 2892.8 rpm p0.33 matching track speed within 0.3%) remain ambiguous (all p_map <0.5). Imbalance, misalignment, bearing, flow not evaluable (evaluable:false) with this video-only capture. Do not conclude rotating fault without high-FPS video or accelerometer/tachometer.

title: Low-frequency structural modes present, not coincident with shaft speed
summary: FDD identified 4 structural modes at 2.11 Hz (zeta 0.107), 3.05 Hz (zeta 0.387), 3.75 Hz (zeta 0.056) and 4.92 Hz (zeta 0.035) with sv_ratio 2.5–6.4 on motor housing + PVC pipe. Campbell criticals list empty and no mode lies near inferred shaft speeds (21–48 Hz). These appear to be support/pipework modes, not shaft criticals in this Nyquist-limited band.

title: No resonance detected in operating sweep
summary: Resonance hypothesis P=0.030 (prior 0.12, evidence db -6.5 for critical speed inside swept range =0). Speed sweep fraction 0.367 covered but identified criticals=0. P(resonance) well below 5% threshold. Optimiser confirms p_res_current 0.0, p_res_proposed 0.0, no exclusion bands required with 10% margin.
